title: Generate initial atomic structures
action: Construct supercell models for eight tBLG twist angles (5°, 7.3°, 9.4°, 13.2°, 21.8°, 32.2°, 38.2°, 42.1°) and six BLG-GB configurations (zigzag: 7.3°, 13.7°, 22.6°; armchair: 17.5°, 20.9°, 27.4°) using ASE to create twisted bilayer graphene and grain boundary structures with appropriate supercell sizes.
description: Generate all atomic structure coordinates and supercell dimensions required for the DFT calculations, and write a summary file documenting the generated models.

title: Relax structures with DFT
action: Perform full geometry relaxation of all tBLG and BLG-GB supercells using Quantum ESPRESSO with PAW pseudopotentials, PBE functional, Grimme D2 vdW correction, a plane-wave cutoff of 400 eV, and 2 nm vacuum space. Relax both supercell dimensions and atomic positions.
description: DFT relaxation to obtain equilibrium geometries. No specific evidence file is required; the relaxed structures are used internally.

title: Run tensile strain simulations
action: For each relaxed structure, apply uniaxial tensile strain along the zigzag direction (tBLG) or perpendicular to the grain boundary line (BLG-GB) in 1% increments. At each strain step, fully relax atomic coordinates, compute the stress component via the stress theorem, and rescale by Z/d (Z=2 nm, d=twice the interlayer distance) to obtain in-plane sheet stress. Record the rescaled stress vs. strain for all configurations in a JSON evidence file.
description: Run uniaxial tensile simulations and collect stress-strain curves. The evidence file documents the raw rescaled stress vs. strain data for all configurations, but it is not directly scored.

title: Extract tBLG mechanical properties
action: From the stress-strain curves for tBLG configurations, determine the intrinsic tensile strength (peak rescaled stress in GPa), critical failure strain (strain at failure in %), and Young's modulus (slope in the elastic regime in GPa) for each twist angle. Write the results to tBLG_results.csv.
description: CSV file with computed mechanical properties of twisted bilayer graphene for eight twist angles.
output_schema: Columns: twist_angle_deg (float), intrinsic_strength_GPa (float), critical_failure_strain_percent (float), Youngs_modulus_GPa (float). One row per twist angle: 5.0, 7.3, 9.4, 13.2, 21.8, 32.2, 38.2, 42.1. Values rounded to two decimals.

title: Extract BLG-GB mechanical properties
action: From the stress-strain curves for BLG-GB configurations, determine the intrinsic tensile strength, critical failure strain, and Young's modulus for each grain boundary. Write results to BLG_GB_results.csv.
description: CSV file with computed mechanical properties of bilayer graphene with one layer containing a grain boundary for six misorientation angles.
output_schema: Columns: misorientation_angle_deg (float), orientation_type (string: 'zigzag' or 'armchair'), intrinsic_strength_GPa (float), critical_failure_strain_percent (float), Youngs_modulus_GPa (float). One row per configuration: 7.3/zigzag, 13.7/zigzag, 22.6/zigzag, 17.5/armchair, 20.9/armchair, 27.4/armchair. Values rounded to two decimals.
